question: In the frozen 125-case ICASSP2022 pure-far corpus, does Sync's fractional sample interpolation materially attenuate the exact delayed reference energy seen by Activity, and does that attenuation explain cross-case public-DTD occupancy?

selection.rule: reuse the exact frozen PR #238 inventory: all complete no-movement ICASSP2022 farend-singletalk mic+lpb pairs at the pinned source revision

observation_method.nearest_reference_definition: for each frame, use the exact ap_sync_get_reference start index render_total - internal_frame - delay_samples, but read the ring sample at each integer index without fractional interpolation
observation_method.interpolated_reference_definition: the actual pipeline->reference produced by unchanged ap_sync_get_reference using drift_credit-clamped linear interpolation
observation_method.sync_reconstruction_crosscheck: independently reconstruct the unchanged interpolation from render_ring/delay_samples/drift_credit and report max absolute error against pipeline->reference
observation_method.valid_frame_rule: interpolation-specific summaries only use frames with reference_start_valid=true; public-DTD baseline summaries remain full common clip

outputs: per-case full-clip public-DTD and existing Activity ratio summaries
per-case valid far-frame nearest-reference energy and actual interpolated-reference energy
per-case valid far-frame interpolation energy ratio and delta dB distributions
per-case valid far-frame mic/nearest-reference ratio summaries
cross-case descriptive Spearman associations between public-DTD occupancy and interpolation attenuation, nearest-reference ratio, and existing synced-reference ratio
prohibited_actions: change sync interpolation, delay tracking, drift compensation, Activity, AEC, RES, NS, AGC, or VAD source
apply nearest-reference audio to the production pipeline
derive or search an interpolation correction constant
derive or search a DTD threshold
derive or search a gain-normalization constant
subsample or hand-pick cases after observing results
treat an association as a classifier, ranking, or source-candidate selector
relax pure-far, movement, echo-path-change, Hosted Real AEC, or other qualification gates
promote to HIL, Product Certification, release, or shipping
interpretation_rule: The diagnostic may determine whether unchanged Sync fractional interpolation materially attenuates the delayed reference and whether that attenuation covaries with pure-far public-DTD occupancy. It cannot authorize changing interpolation, DTD thresholds, gain normalization, or any source candidate.
